en: Changed `/ultrareview` uploads on macOS and Linux to refuse, instead of fetching, a partial clone missing some of its working tree's files on older git versions; a clone made without `--filter` uploads
zh: 变更 macOS 和 Linux 上的 `/ultrareview` 上传：在较旧 git 版本上，若部分克隆缺少其工作树的部分文件，现在会拒绝上传而不是获取；未使用 `--filter` 创建的克隆仍会上传
